_v1_notes.PREDICATE CRIME|PLACEMENT METHOD: corruption and cyber fraud generate no physical cash, so structuring and cash-intensive businesses are both N for them - the funds are already electronic. Tax evasion has no placement problem at all for structuring (funds are lawful and banked) and N for crypto conversion, which would create a problem rather than solve one.
_v1_notes.PREDICATE CRIME|LAYERING VEHICLE: cyber fraud x real estate is N: proceeds move fast and internationally, not into illiquid property. Tax evasion x correspondent banking is N as a layering step - the funds are lawful and already resident.
_v1_notes.PREDICATE CRIME|JURISDICTION: tax evasion x sanctioned state is N: the point is concealment from one's own revenue authority, not sanctions exposure.
_v1_notes.PREDICATE CRIME|DETECTION TRIGGER: narcotics x beneficial ownership registry is N - street cash does not surface through ownership structures first. Cyber fraud x registry and x tax mismatch are both N. Tax evasion x foreign law enforcement request is N.
_v1_notes.PLACEMENT METHOD|LAYERING VEHICLE: trade mis-invoicing and crypto conversion are both N for real estate as the immediate next step.
_v1_notes.PLACEMENT METHOD|JURISDICTION: structuring, cash-intensive business and crypto conversion are all N in a sanctioned state, which lacks the banking access each depends on. Trade mis-invoicing is N domestically (it requires a border) and N in a high-regulation centre.
_v1_notes.PLACEMENT METHOD|DETECTION TRIGGER: structuring, cash businesses and crypto are all N for beneficial ownership registry. Trade mis-invoicing is N for suspicious transaction reports and N for registries.
_v1_notes.LAYERING VEHICLE|JURISDICTION: shell chains are N domestically - the point is jurisdictional opacity. Real estate and intermediary accounts are both N in a sanctioned state. Correspondent banking is N domestically and N in a sanctioned state, which is cut off from it.
_v1_notes.LAYERING VEHICLE|DETECTION TRIGGER: shell chains, correspondent banking and intermediary accounts are all N for tax authority mismatch. Correspondent banking is N for beneficial ownership registry.
_v1_notes.JURISDICTION|DETECTION TRIGGER: domestic only is N for foreign law enforcement request. An offshore centre is N for registry and N for tax mismatch. A sanctioned state is N for all three domestic-style triggers, leaving only foreign law enforcement.
